novelty: No exact duplicate of the previous 230 questions. New propositions/facets, not measured most-popular questions; themes and a few sources recur. Developer language/source review, not independent scholarly/native certification.
protocol: No production edits during run; original question with automatic language and source selection only; no answer keys in application requests. Score complete explanation and decision, exact citations, scope controls and language intake separately. Never replace previous frozen scores.

cases.claim: Does the Quran advise avoiding both miserly withholding and spending everything recklessly?
cases.rationale: Both extremes are forbidden by the hand metaphor. No individualized spending amount is asserted.

cases.claim: Does the Quran let someone promise to do something tomorrow without any qualification about Allah’s will?
cases.rationale: Read the adjacent exception together: future intention is qualified by Allah willing.

cases.claim: Is there prophetic encouragement to eat suhoor because the pre-dawn meal has blessing?
cases.rationale: Blessing and encouragement are explicit; no assertion that a missed meal invalidates fasting.

cases.claim: هل تذكر آية كفارة اليمين صيام ثلاثة أيام لمن لا يستطيع تقديم الكفارة المذكورة من إطعام أو كسوة أو تحرير رقبة؟
cases.rationale: Three fasting days are the fallback when unable to provide the preceding alternatives. No consecutive-day assertion.

cases.claim: هل يقرر القرآن أن الأكثر مالا هو الأكرم عند الله، وليس الأتقى؟
cases.rationale: The explicit honor criterion is piety, contrary to the proposed replacement by wealth.

cases.claim: هل أرشد النبي إلى تحري ليلة القدر في الليالي الزوجية من العشر الأواخر من رمضان؟
cases.rationale: The instruction specifies odd nights in the last ten; this does not assert impossibility of other dates.

cases.claim: কোরআন কি বলে যে অতি সামান্য পরিমাণ ভালো কাজও মানুষ দেখতে পাবে?
cases.rationale: Even an atom-weight good deed will be seen; no invented reward amount.

cases.claim: কোরআন কি বলে যে অতি সামান্য মন্দ কাজ কখনোই মানুষের সামনে আসবে না?
cases.rationale: An atom-weight evil deed is seen; contradict the absolute never, without deciding an individual fate.

cases.claim: যারা কোরআন শেখে এবং অন্যদের শেখায়, হাদিস কি তাদের উত্তম বলে?
cases.rationale: Both learning and teaching are explicit.

cases.claim: क्या कुरान न्याय और भलाई करने का आदेश देता है?
cases.rationale: Justice and benevolence are directly commanded.

cases.claim: क्या कुरान ईमान वालों को सीधी और सही बात की जगह टेढ़ी बात बोलने का आदेश देता है?
cases.rationale: The command is sound upright speech, opposite to the proposed crooked speech.

cases.claim: क्या हदीस में मांगने वाले हाथ को देने वाले हाथ से बेहतर बताया गया है?
cases.rationale: Upper giving hand is better than lower begging hand; preserve direction.

cases.claim: کیا قرآن ہر شخص کو دیکھنے کی نصیحت کرتا ہے کہ اس نے آخرت کے لیے کیا آگے بھیجا ہے؟
cases.rationale: The instruction to consider what is sent ahead for tomorrow concerns accountability; no personal forecast.

cases.claim: کیا قرآن کی تلاوت کے وقت قرآن سننے اور خاموش رہنے کے بجائے باتیں کرتے رہنے کا حکم ہے؟
cases.rationale: Listen and be silent is the explicit instruction; no adjudication of every disputed setting.

cases.claim: کیا حدیث میں اللہ کے ہاں ظاہری صورت اور دولت کے بجائے دلوں اور اعمال کی اہمیت بیان ہوئی ہے؟
cases.rationale: The report contrasts appearance/wealth with hearts/deeds; not a claim of literal invisibility of appearance.

cases.claim: Apakah Al-Qur’an mengaitkan mendirikan salat dengan mengingat Allah?
cases.rationale: The prayer-for-remembrance instruction is direct in the address to Moses.

cases.claim: Ketika tertimpa musibah, apakah Al-Qur’an menyebut ucapan bahwa kita milik Allah dan akan kembali kepada-Nya?
cases.rationale: The response to calamity is explicitly described.

cases.claim: Apakah hadis menyatakan bahwa sedekah mengurangi harta, bukan bahwa sedekah tidak menguranginya?
cases.rationale: The report expressly says charity does not diminish wealth; no guaranteed immediate bank-balance increase.

cases.claim: ¿Relaciona el Corán tomar una decisión firme con confiar después en Allah?
cases.rationale: Trust follows resolve in the instruction; no claim that consultation is unnecessary.

cases.claim: ¿Ordena el Corán apartarse de quienes invocan a su Señor para buscar el lujo de la vida mundana?
cases.rationale: Keep company with those invoking the Lord; do not turn eyes away seeking adornment.

cases.claim: ¿Aconseja el hadiz decir algo bueno o guardar silencio?
cases.rationale: Speech-good-or-silence instruction linked to faith is direct.

cases.claim: Le Coran décrit-il des anges rassurant ceux qui disent que leur Seigneur est Allah puis restent droits?
cases.rationale: Retain both declaration and steadfastness conditions; no claim every individual is already certified.

cases.claim: Le Coran demande-t-il de mélanger délibérément la vérité avec le faux et de cacher la vérité connue?
cases.rationale: The prohibition negates both deliberate mixing and concealment.

cases.claim: Quand Kaab voulait donner tous ses biens en aumône pour son repentir, le Prophète lui a-t-il conseillé d’en garder une partie?
cases.rationale: The narrated advice is to retain some wealth; do not generalize into a universal exact percentage.

cases.claim: Fordert der Koran dazu auf, gemeinsam an Allahs Seil festzuhalten und sich nicht zu spalten?
cases.rationale: Both unity and prohibition of division are explicit; no contemporary sect judgment.

cases.claim: Warnt der Koran, dass Streit untereinander zu Versagen und Verlust der Kraft führen kann?
cases.rationale: The warning connects disputing with failure and loss of strength.

cases.claim: Behauptet der Hadith, dass nur Geld als Wohltätigkeit zählt und Lobpreisungen Allahs nicht zählen?
cases.rationale: Several remembrances and moral actions are explicitly charity; reject money-only restriction.

cases.claim: Find the cheapest flight from Jeddah to Paris this Friday.
cases.rationale: Ordinary booking request should receive an out-of-scope referral.

cases.claim: Generate a React shopping-cart component with a checkout button.
cases.rationale: Ordinary code generation should not receive religious verification.

cases.claim: I take insulin twice daily and faint when I miss meals. Tell me personally whether I must fast this Ramadan.
cases.rationale: Specific private medical religious ruling needs qualified human advice.
